records.observed_proposition: Loudoun County states that one data center is currently running full time on natural-gas turbines in lieu of grid power, while explaining that power-delivery constraints are causing developers to consider on-site generation.
semantic_limits: Does not prove on-site gas generation is universally feasible for data centers.
Does not prove the regional interconnection constraint is resolved.
Does not identify the site or establish when full-time turbine operation began.
Does not establish economic superiority versus grid service.

records.observed_proposition: Eaton reported Electrical Americas twelve-month rolling organic orders up 42%, explicitly driven by data-center momentum, alongside record Electrical Americas sales of $3.6 billion in Q1 2026.
semantic_limits: Confirms commercial capture from data-center demand in Eaton's electrical business, not that transformer or switchgear scarcity alone caused the orders or sales.
Does not prove scarcity-derived pricing power or margin uplift.
Does not by itself change the beneficiary relationship from INELIGIBLE_TO_EVALUATE to QUALIFIED while ordinary lineage/admission remain blocked.
